lines.t:
A grand move that draws out the full latent power of
the <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c>. Once thought dangerous as a {{medal}}'s
{{runaway}} power, it is now an officially recognized <c:ffff00>act<c>
in a <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c>.
It needs the <c:ffff00>{{charge_gauge}}<c> at 100% and uses it all.
By <c:ffff00>{{rank}}<c>, a <c:ffff00>{{medal}}<c> can use up to 3 types.
A higher <c:ffff00>{{medal_level}}<c> speeds <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c>.
The <c:ffff00>{{acting_part}}<c> is the <c:ffff00>head<c>; other <c:ffff00>slots<c> join by type.
